title: Sustainable hydrogen production via NH3BH3 hydrolysis using platinum nanoparticles decorated on solvent-free synthesized LiNbWO6
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36127-36136
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04670J, Paper
Open Access

Noemí Cristina Silva de Souza, Beatriz Rodrigues Olímpio, Gessica do Carmo Dias, Juliana Peña Gomes, Kleryton Luiz Alves de Oliveira, Didier Astruc, Tiago Almeida Silva, Geraldo Magela de Lima, Renata Pereira Lopes Moreira
A novel catalyst for the controlled and safe evolution of hydrogen (H2) fuel from ammonia borane (NH3BH3) is presented in this work based on platinum nanoparticles (PtNPs) decorated on LiNbWO6 support.
